summary: A small utility firmware with no sound, meant as a safer stopover when moving between custom firmwares. It presents itself to installers as the official V15 and protects the next install against interrupted writes.
features: Makes no sound and stores nothing; shows a ready screen
ChoralRoot's boot stub falls back to update mode after a cut write
Its own loader writes the next firmware, first sector last
Not for V16 or Baud Girl: go through official V15 instead
Supports newer units with the front logo since 0.1.4

headings: how much of each write is protected
